BC_description: Starting with Commander.js v13.0.0, constructing an Option with unsupported option flag formats will throw an error during construction. Previously, passing certain invalid flag specifications (such as a short flag with more than one character after a single '-' like '-ab', or providing more than one long flag such as '--foo, --bar', or using multi-letter short flags like '-es') resulted in undefined or inconsistent behavior, but did not immediately throw; now such usages will cause an immediate exception. Only supported flag patterns are allowed: a single-character short flag after a single '-' (e.g., '-a') and a single long flag after '--' (e.g., '--foo'). Attempting to use concatenated short flags, multi-letter short options, or multiple long option names in a single Option declaration will throw an error during Option construction in v13.0.0. (Support for dual long options, as an exception, is added back in v13.1.0.)
